W.note: Very practical (fast leave, focus-visible, reduced motion, opacity-only glow) but the hover is a faint glow and light pass on a dark solid button, more polite than ethereal.

X.note: Slow fog-like bezier drift with colour bloom, motes and soft overshoot, serif card and pearly button feel genuinely ethereal, with a reduced-motion fallback, though 1-2s durations and blur layers cost some practicality.

Y.note: Pastel iridescent bloom with sparkle icon and long eased transitions reads dreamy and coherent, but the label sits on shifting gradients and slow 1s+ timings are a little heavy for a real form.

Z.note: Clean landing page with a state readout and solid accessibility, but the hover is a quick sheen and dot pulse on a navy pill that barely registers as dreamlike.
